headword: {補習授業|ほしゅうじゅぎょう}
gloss: supplementary lessons; remedial classes; extra classes

definitions.gloss: supplementary lessons; remedial classes; extra instruction given to help students catch up or prepare for exams
definitions.explanation: Additional classes held outside the regular schedule, either to help struggling students catch up with coursework or to provide extra preparation for exams. Often held during breaks or after school.

examples.english: There are supplementary classes during summer break.

notes:
Combines ⟦{補習|ほしゅう}→補習：09603_hoshuu⟧ (supplementary study) and ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧ (class, lesson). Often shortened to just ⟦{補習|ほしゅう}→補習：09603_hoshuu⟧ in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {補習授業|ほしゅうじゅぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to take supplementary lessons
- {補習授業|ほしゅうじゅぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold supplementary lessons
- ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{補習授業|ほしゅうじゅぎょう}: summer break supplementary classes
- ⟦{放課後|ほうかご}→放課後：12720_houkago⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{補習授業|ほしゅうじゅぎょう}: after-school supplementary classes

USAGE:
Very common in Japanese schools. Many high schools hold {補習授業|ほしゅうじゅぎょう} during summer and winter breaks, especially in the lead-up to university entrance exams. The word can refer to both remedial classes (for struggling students) and exam-prep sessions (for all students). In casual speech, often just called ⟦{補習|ほしゅう}→補習：09603_hoshuu⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{補習|ほしゅう}→補習：09603_hoshuu⟧: supplementary study — the shortened form, used more casually
- ⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧: cram school — a private after-school school, whereas {補習授業|ほしゅうじゅぎょう} is run by the school itself
- ⟦{追試|ついし}→追試：09971_tsuishi⟧: make-up exam — a re-test for students who failed, not extra lessons
